verses.1: You are a righteous God, O Jehovah! For I will speak to you with truth. But I will speak of your laws in a way that the wicked do not understand. All their lies and deceitfulness will be revealed.
verses.2: They were also planted with roots that would grow and bear fruit. You are in their mouths, yet they are far from all their desires.
verses.3: And you, LORD, know me; you see me. You have set my heart upon you. You will make me like a lamb for sacrifice, and I will be honored in your sight all day long.
verses.4: Until death, the land will be desolate; every plant in the fields will wither from the evil deeds of those who live there. It will be destroyed by destruction and chaos, because they said, “We will not see our neighbors.”
verses.5: For you have rushed upon your feet, and they have been destroyed. How can you control the horses in a land of peace? And how can you act with pride in the valley of Jordan?
verses.6: For even your brothers and your father’s house have also spoken against you. They have called upon others to support you. Do not trust them; they may be speaking falsely to you.
verses.7: I have left my home; I have abandoned my inheritance. I have given up my soul to the hands of those who are evil.
verses.8: It was my fate to be like a lion in the forest. She gave me that fate through her voice. Thus, I became her favorite.
verses.9: The land of the wild animals is mine. All the animals in that land will be gathered here for food.
verses.10: Many nations have plundered my vineyards; they have taken away my portion. They have given away my share of wealth to the desert.
verses.11: She lay down on her bed, but all the land was empty because there was no one there to protect it.
verses.12: In all the seas of the coast, invaders came. For God had destroyed everything. From one end of the earth to the other, there was no peace for any living being.
verses.13: They sowed wheat, but its sprouts were short. They would not grow into plants. From among your crops, there would be nothing left to harvest. May the Lord have mercy on you!
verses.14: Thus said Jehovah: “All those evil neighbors who live in the land that I have given to My people, Israel. I will destroy them from their land and from their homes.”
verses.15: And after Nathshi had punished them, he would return and forgive them. Then each person would be given back to their own land.
verses.16: And if they learn the ways of My people, so that they may worship Me in His name. May the Lord live, as they learn the ways of My people to worship Him. And let them be built within the midst of My people.
verses.17: And if they do not listen, and I destroy that nation completely, then may Jehovah destroy them too.
